Definition: the crown of the head (as the part most bowed)
BiblicalUsage: Absalom is praised from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head, with no blemish in him. The curse runs the same measure: from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Absalom's perfect crown of head could not save him, and the law's curse runs from sole to crown.
